title: Authorization Proof — zkML Extension
description: Optional cryptographic proof that AI agent authorization was computed correctly

AuthorizationProof.description: Zero-knowledge machine learning proof of authorization decision

proof.description: Hex-encoded zkML proof bytes (e.g., JOLT, Groth16, PLONK, STARK)

proof_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the proof for integrity verification

model_hash.description: Hash identifier of the authorization model used (format: 'type_hash' or 'sha256:hash')

decision.description: Authorization decision: true = approved, false = denied

confidence.description: Confidence score of the authorization decision

inputs_hash.description: Hash of the model inputs used (for verification without revealing actual inputs)

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when proof was generated

verification_url.description: Optional URL to on-chain verification transaction (e.g., Etherscan link)
